```{r}

# --- CREATE TRAINING DATASET --- #


# Loop through each threshold level to import and process datasets.

for(i in 1:length(threshold_levels)){
  
  training_individuals[[i]] = read.csv(here("1_data",
                                            paste0(threshold_levels[i],
                                                   "_threshold_analysis"),
                                            "training.csv")) %>%
  filter(species != "Eug") %>% # Exclude Euglena from training monocultures to prevent misidentification (Eug was only in autotrophic ecosystems).
  mutate(species = case_when(species == "Spi te" ~ "Spi_te",
                             TRUE ~ species),
         comment = NULL,
         file = as.numeric(str_extract(file, "\\d+"))) %>% # Extract numeric file identifier from the file name.
  filter(complete.cases(.)) %>% # Remove rows with any NA values to ensure complete cases.
  select(file,
         id,
         species,
         N_frames,
         mean_area,
         everything())

}

# Create a dataset excluding the species "Ble" for threshold 13. 
# This is necessary because at threshold 13, we could not eliminate 
# the food source (Chi) for "Ble".

ds_individuals_13 = training_individuals[[1]] %>% 
  filter(species != "Ble")  # Filter out "Ble" species

# Create a dataset including only the species "Ble" for threshold 40. 
# At threshold 40, we successfully eliminated the food source (Chi) 
# for "Ble", allowing for its inclusion in the analysis.


ds_individuals_40 = training_individuals[[2]] %>% 
  filter(species == "Ble")  # Filter for "Ble" species only

# Bind the two previous datasets

training_individuals = rbind(ds_individuals_13,
                             ds_individuals_40)
```

```{r}

# --- CREATE PREDICTIVE MODEL --- #
# See where we previously set the parameters for a description of these variables. 

species_ID_model = svm(factor(species) ~
                         mean_grey +
                         sd_grey +
                         mean_area +
                         sd_area +
                         mean_perimeter +
                         mean_turning +
                         sd_turning +
                         sd_perimeter +
                         mean_major +
                         sd_major +
                         mean_minor +
                         sd_minor +
                         mean_ar +
                         sd_ar +
                         duration +
                         max_net  +
                         net_disp +
                         net_speed +
                         gross_disp +
                         max_step +
                         min_step +
                         sd_step +
                         sd_gross_speed +
                         max_gross_speed +
                         min_gross_speed ,
                       data = training_individuals,
                       probability = T,
                       na.action = na.pass)
```

```{r}

# --- SHOW CONFUSION MATRIX --- #

# Create a confusion matrix comparing the fitted species predictions from the SVM model 
# with the actual species labels from the training dataset.

confusion_matrix = table(species_ID_model$fitted, training_individuals$species)

# Create a copy of the confusion matrix to modify for error calculation.

confusion_matrix_with_diagonal_zeros = confusion_matrix

# Set the diagonal elements (true positives) to zero for error calculation.
# This allows us to compute the misclassification errors without counting the correct classifications.

diag(confusion_matrix_with_diagonal_zeros) = 0 

# Calculate the class error for each species.
# Class error is defined as the ratio of misclassified samples to the total samples for each species.

confusion_matrix = cbind(
  confusion_matrix,
  class_error = rowSums(confusion_matrix_with_diagonal_zeros) / rowSums(confusion_matrix)
) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(class_error_percentage = class_error * 100, # Convert class error to percentage
         class_error = NULL)  # Remove the original class_error column for clarity.

# Display the final confusion matrix with class errors as a data frame.

confusion_matrix
```

```{r}

# --- ID SPECIES --- #

ds_individuals = ds_individuals %>% 
  filter(complete.cases(.)) %>%
  mutate(
    species = as.character(predict(object = species_ID_model, 
                                    ., 
                                    type = "response")),  # Predict species based on features in 'ds_individuals'.
    species = ifelse(trophic_type == "autotrophic", 
                     "Eug", 
                     species)) # Assign species "Eug" for autotrophic trophic types, overriding the model's prediction.
    
```
